facility.name: Imagination Express Learning Center, LLC
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The wooden fence in the outdoor playground was observed with peeling paint and a broken picket. Brush was observed growing through and over a metal fence from the neighboring property into the outdoor playground. This posed a safety hazard as the brush was accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves: A caregiver did not wash their hands after conducting a diaper change in the toddler room.       Note: This was addressed during the inspection and the caregiver washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Use Disposable Gloves (26 TAC §746.3505(c))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The emergency preparedness plan reviewed did not include the procedures how children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter, including specific procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments; and     the name and address of the alternate shelter away from the center that will be  used as needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Discard Single-Service Items: Single-use disposable foam cups were labeled with each child's name in the afterschool room. According to the caregiver the children reuse the same disposable cup through out the day.      Note: This was addressed during inspection and the labeled foam cups were discarded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Discard Single-Service Items (26 TAC §746.3317(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not wash a child's hands after a diaper change in the toddler room.       Note:This was addressed during inspection and the child's hands were washed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Brush was observed growing through and over a metal fence from the neighboring property in the school-aged  children's outdoor playground. This posed a safety hazard as the brush was accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): 1 of 6 personnel records reviewed was missing the Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations (Form 2912).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect: The operational policies reviewed did not include the following information:     (B) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect, including warning signs that a child may be a victim of abuse or neglect and factors indicating a child is at risk for abuse or neglect;     (C) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of prevention techniques for child abuse and neglect; and    (D) Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data from January 21, 2025, revealed the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a broken tree branch at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm in one transportation vehicle was not working properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The vent in two classrooms was observed with dust and debris.    Corrected at Inspection: The vents were cleaned during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: There was no gas leak inspection conducted for the child care operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: An infant was asleep facing down in the play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children: There was a 5- gallon bucket full of water outside the door of the Infant room in the playground area.     Note: The bucket was emptied and removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(8))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Director did not have a current Transportation Training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: Trainings hours for two employees were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose fill surfacing, pea gravel, for two play structures was not at the required depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher in one of the transportation vehicles was last serviced on March 2020.  One of the transportation vehicles was observed with used faced mask and candy wrappers on the floor.     Corrected at Inspection: The fire extinguisher was serviced during the inspection. The trash from the transportation vehicle was removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The wooden garden borders were damage exposing the nails on the connection corners. There was garden shovel accessible to the children during outdoor play. There was a bench with chipped paint at the school age playground area. There were two pieces of broken metal pole which pose a risk for the children during outdoor play.    There was a wooden bridge and play structure with chipped paint at the toddler/infant outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: An employee record did not have documentation showing how the employee meets the education requirements.     Corrected at Inspection: The employee will not working as a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The child safety alarm for a transportation vehicle was not working properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))
